title: Phát triển phần mềm mã nguồn mở và ứng dụng

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master the process of developing open source software.
Manage and coordinate group activities effectively.
Enhance written communication skills and professional presentations.
Apply problem-solving techniques to develop and implement open source software applications.
Develop and implement open source software applications using programming languages such as Python.
Manage and use open source database systems such as MySQL.
Use version control systems such as Git for software development.
Utilize Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) such as Eclipse and NetBeans for software development.
Understand and apply open source software licenses.
Work independently or collaboratively in a team setting.
